name: rotor-tilt-hold
note: FAMILY D2, THE O13 PRE-FIX BASELINE. FLY THIS BEFORE THE O13 FIX SHIPS. That is not a preference, it is the entire point: the confirming test for the tiltwing-blend fix is a BEFORE/AFTER on one condition, and shipping the fix first destroys the before. There is no way to reconstruct it from the corpus - rotor-transition's R41/R42 captures are a decelerating sweep at MinThrottle, not a held condition, and they stalled at 60 m/s. THE DEFECT. ChaseController's tiltwing branch reads the game's tilt command and treats it as a HOVER FRACTION with the wrong sense. The rotorcraft (_sds) branch carries a '1f -' that the tiltwing branch does not, and the game pins the hover end of its tilt range at 0.18 rather than 0. So tiltFrac reads high in WING-BORNE cruise, where it must read ~0, and because _heliBlend = MAX(speedRamp, tiltFrac) it drags the blend up with it - deleting the bank-to-turn demand (tBankE *= (1 - heliBlend)) and boosting yaw by HeliYawScale in exactly the regime where the aircraft is a wing. R42 measured tiltFrac FALLING as the aircraft decelerated toward the hover (0.620 at 100-110 m/s down to 0.182 at 60-70), which is backwards, and LAW-LEDGER.md X30 records that a plain sign flip does not fit either - flipped, it reads 0.380 at 108 m/s where it must be ~0. The 0.18 pin is the missing piece. PASS / FAIL, AND THE SENSE IS DELIBERATELY INVERTED FROM THE USUAL. TODAY, PRE-FIX, heliBlend must read >= 0.8 in the most wing-borne condition this airframe has. That is the inversion proving itself at its worst case and it is what this card is here to RECORD. AFTER the fix the same card must read <= 0.2. A pre-fix reading already below 0.8 means the defect is milder than X30 implies and the fix's target moves; a pre-fix reading near 1.0 means the bank channel is entirely deleted in cruise. Either way the number is the baseline and cannot be re-taken later. PRECONDITION, CHECK IT FIRST: the spawn's '[helofbw]' line must read tiltwing=1. If TiltWingController did not resolve, the tilt term never ran, heliBlend is the speed ramp by construction and every number below is meaningless. R42 confirmed tiltwing=1 on this airframe. ENTRY 120 m/s at 3000 m, held rather than swept - the opposite of rotor-transition, which is why this is a separate card and not an edit to that one. 120 is well above the shipped HeliForwardSpeed 60, so speedRamp is identically 0.000 and heliBlend IS tiltFrac: a direct readout with no max() hiding anything. 60 s at az 0 establishes the boresight baseline; 60 s at az 8 excites the turn channel inside the measured 11 deg pedal-saturation knee, so the bank-vs-yaw allocation is visible as well as the blend value. count 2 = TWO QuadVTOL1 LANES wrapping the one-key list, at zero wall-clock cost. Same reasoning as rotor-transition: this card's whole question lives on one airframe and a lost lane ('aircraft gone' is fatal and takes the lane's remaining replicates) would be the whole baseline gone in an unattended run. SCORING NOTE: the fine/az tags here score as fine_track and az_step, which DO call wobble_scan - unlike rotor-transition's 'transition' tag, which computes only altExcursionM plus the generic block. That is a deliberate improvement on the older card, not an accident of naming. THIS ARM: THROTTLE 1.00, the wing-borne arm and the baseline of record. Full throttle at 120 m/s keeps the aircraft as wing-borne as it can get, which is the condition the >= 0.8 pre-fix criterion is stated against. Read heliBlend, tiltFrac and the game's own wing angle together. R44 VERDICT (2026-08-05): VALID, AND THE BASELINE IS RECORDED - THE O13 FIX IS UNBLOCKED. 10/10 captures, tiltwing=1 confirmed in the spawn log, speedRamp identically 0 on every scored row so heliBlend IS tiltFrac as designed. BASELINE OF RECORD: az8thhi heliBlend = 1.0000, sd 0.0000, n=10 captures / 9602 of 9602 rows exactly 1.000; fineTHhi 0.9915 +/- 0.0170 (the sub-unity rows are the spawn chase from 93 m/s). The >= 0.8 criterion is confirmed AT SATURATION - the worst branch the note anticipated - so tBankE *= (1 - heliBlend) is exactly 0 and the bank-to-turn channel is entirely deleted in cruise. POST-FIX THIS CARD MUST READ 0.000 (InverseLerp(1, 0.18, 1.000)); anything else means the fix did not land. ONE CARD CAVEAT: the arm did NOT hold its declared 120 m/s - full throttle accelerated it to 152.5 m/s mean / 152.9 max, ABOVE QuadVTOL1's Vmax of 148.6 (AIRFRAMES.md), while descending 3000 -> 2494 m. That does not touch the blend readout, which saturates far below 148, but if this card is ever re-cut for a speed-sensitive question the entry needs holding. See LAW-LEDGER.md O13 and GENERALITY-REVIEW.md finding 19.
